targets.quote: 1.   Member States shall ensure that, in their territory, publicly accessible recharging stations dedicated to light-duty electric vehicles are deployed in a way that is commensurate with the uptake of light-duty electric vehicles and that they provide sufficient power output for those vehicles.
targets.article: Article 3(1) — Targets for recharging infrastructure dedicated to light-duty electric vehicles
targets.label: target
indicators: publicly accessible recharging stations
power output

targets.quote: for each light-duty battery electric vehicle registered in their territory, a total power output of at least 1,3 kW is provided through publicly accessible recharging stations; and
targets.label: target
targets.timeline: end of each year, starting from 2024
indicators: total power output per light-duty battery electric vehicle (kW)

targets.quote: for each light-duty plug-in hybrid vehicle registered in their territory, a total power output of at least 0,80 kW is provided through publicly accessible recharging stations.
targets.label: target
targets.timeline: end of each year, starting from 2024
indicators: total power output per light-duty plug-in hybrid vehicle (kW)

targets.quote: along the TEN-T core road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to light-duty electric vehicles and meeting the following requirements are deployed in each direction of travel with a maximum distance of 60 km between them:
targets.label: target
indicators: recharging pools along TEN-T core road network
maximum distance (km)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2025, each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 400 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 150 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: recharging pool power output (kW)
individual recharging point power output (kW)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2027, each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 600 kW and includes at least two recharging points with an individual power output of at least 150 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: recharging pool power output (kW)
individual recharging point power output (kW)

targets.quote: along the TEN-T comprehensive road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to light-duty electric vehicles and meeting the following requirements are deployed in each direction of travel with a maximum distance of 60 km between them:

indicators: recharging pools along TEN-T comprehensive road network
maximum distance (km)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2027, along at least 50 % of the length of the TEN-T comprehensive road network, each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 300 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 150 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: share of TEN-T comprehensive road network length (%)
recharging pool power output (kW)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2030, each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 300 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 150 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: recharging pool power output (kW)
individual recharging point power output (kW)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2035, each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 600 kW and includes at least two recharging points with an individual power output of at least 150 kW.

individual recharging point power output (kW)

targets.quote: 1.   Member States shall ensure a minimum coverage of publicly accessible recharging points dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles in their territory.
targets.article: Article 4(1) — Targets for recharging infrastructure dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles
targets.label: target
indicators: minimum coverage of publicly accessible recharging points

targets.quote: by 31 December 2025, along at least 15 % of the length of the TEN-T road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles are deployed in each direction of travel and that each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 1 400 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 350 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: share of TEN-T road network length (%)
recharging pool power output (kW)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2027, along at least 50 % of the length of the TEN-T road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles are deployed in each direction of travel and that each recharging pool:

indicators: share of TEN-T road network length (%)

targets.quote: along the TEN-T core road network, offers a power output of at least 2 800 kW and includes at least two recharging points with an individual power output of at least 350 kW;

indicators: recharging pool power output along TEN-T core (kW)

targets.quote: along the TEN-T comprehensive road network, offers a power output of at least 1 400 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 350 kW;

indicators: recharging pool power output along TEN-T comprehensive (kW)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2030, along the TEN-T core road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles are deployed in each direction of travel with a maximum distance of 60 km between them and that each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 3 600 kW and includes at least two recharging points with an individual power output of at least 350 kW;
targets.label: target
indicators: recharging pool power output along TEN-T core (kW)
maximum distance (km)

targets.quote: by 31 December 2030, along the TEN-T comprehensive road network, publicly accessible recharging pools dedicated to heavy-duty electric vehicles are deployed in each direction of travel with a maximum distance of 100 km between them and each recharging pool offers a power output of at least 1 500 kW and includes at least one recharging point with an individual power output of at least 350 kW;

maximum distance (km)

power output (kW)

targets.quote: 1.   Member States shall ensure that, in their territory, a minimum number of publicly accessible hydrogen refuelling stations are deployed by 31 December 2030.
targets.article: Article 6(1) — Targets for hydrogen refuelling infrastructure of road vehicles
targets.label: target
indicators: publicly accessible hydrogen refuelling stations

targets.quote: To that end, Member States shall ensure that by 31 December 2030 publicly accessible hydrogen refuelling stations designed for a minimum cumulative capacity of 1 tonne per day and equipped with at least a 700 bar dispenser are deployed with a maximum distance of 200 km between them along the TEN-T core network.
targets.label: target
indicators: hydrogen refuelling station capacity (tonnes/day)
dispenser pressure (bar)
maximum distance along TEN-T core (km)

targets.quote: Member States shall ensure that, by 31 December 2030, at least one publicly accessible hydrogen refuelling station is deployed in each urban node. Member States shall ensure that an analysis is carried out to determine the best location for such refuelling stations and that the analysis examines in particular the deployment of such refuelling stations in multimodal hubs where other transport modes could also be supplied.
targets.label: target
indicators: hydrogen refuelling stations per urban node

targets.quote: 1.   Member States shall ensure that a minimum shore-side electricity supply for seagoing container ships and seagoing passenger ships is provided in TEN-T maritime ports.
targets.article: Article 9(1) — Targets for shore-side electricity supply in maritime ports
targets.label: target
indicators: minimum shore-side electricity supply in TEN-T maritime ports

targets.quote: TEN-T core maritime ports and TEN-T comprehensive maritime ports for which the annual number of port calls of ships that are moored at the quayside, averaged over the last three years, by seagoing container ships above 5 000 gross tonnes is above 100 are equipped to provide each year shore-side electricity supply for at least 90 % of the total number of port calls of seagoing container ships above 5 000 gross tonnes that are moored at the quayside at the maritime port concerned;
targets.label: target
indicators: shore-side electricity supply for seagoing container ships (% of port calls)

targets.quote: TEN-T core maritime ports and TEN-T comprehensive maritime ports for which the annual number of port calls of ships that are moored at the quayside, averaged over the last three years, by seagoing ro-ro passenger ships above 5 000 gross tonnes and seagoing high-speed passenger craft above 5 000 gross tonnes is above 40 are equipped to provide each year shore-side electricity supply for at least 90 % of the total number of port calls of seagoing ro-ro passenger ships above 5 000 gross tonnes and seagoing high-speed passenger craft above 5 000 gross tonnes that are moored at the quayside at the maritime port concerned;
targets.label: target
indicators: shore-side electricity supply for ro-ro and high-speed passenger craft (% of port calls)

targets.quote: TEN-T core maritime ports and TEN-T comprehensive maritime ports for which the annual number of port calls of ships that are moored at the quayside, averaged over the last three years, by seagoing passenger ships above 5 000 gross tonnes other than seagoing ro-ro passenger ships and seagoing high-speed passenger craft is above 25 are equipped to provide each year shore-side electricity supply for at least 90 % of the total number of port calls of seagoing passenger ships above 5 000 gross tonnes other than seagoing ro-ro passenger ships and seagoing high-speed passenger craft that are moored at the quayside at the maritime port concerned.
targets.label: target
indicators: shore-side electricity supply for other seagoing passenger ships (% of port calls)

targets.quote: at least one installation providing shore-side electricity supply to inland waterway vessels is deployed at all TEN-T core inland waterway ports by 31 December 2024;

targets.label: target
indicators: shore-side electricity installations at TEN-T core inland waterway ports

targets.quote: at least one installation providing shore-side electricity supply to inland waterway vessels is deployed at all TEN-T comprehensive inland waterway ports by 31 December 2029.
targets.label: target
indicators: shore-side electricity installations at TEN-T comprehensive inland waterway ports
